units: micrometres (um); x to the right, y downwards, origin top-left of the chamber image
open_side: right edge, x = 34 (main flow channel; cells pushed past it leave the chamber)
cell_shape: capsule (rod with round ends): length_um is the total tip-to-tip length, width_um the diameter; area = (L - w) * w + pi * w^2 / 4
angle_rad: angle of the long axis from the +x axis, measured towards +y (downwards), in radians
organism: Escherichia coli, phase contrast, 5 min between frames, growth medium flows past the open side
